_comment: The garage's words: the garage screen, the parts workbench and engine stand, the car's sheet, the repair bay,
the career dialog and its messages, the victory screen. A label is said one way (the first line of its pool).
{name} is a value the game fills in; {name:format} a number or date it writes that way. Sums of money come
written already ($1,234). The values each key takes:

lines.garage.save_warning: The work on the car is done, but the game could not be saved. It is saved again the next time something changes.
lines.garage.save_warning.title: Save Warning
lines.garage.wont_run.title: Car Won't Run
lines.garage.wont_run.damage:
The car is not going anywhere: {damage}.

{fix}
lines.garage.wont_run.problem: The car is not going anywhere: {problem}.
lines.garage.launch_error.title: Launch Error
lines.garage.free_run_failed:
Could not start the free run:

{error}
lines.garage.no_strip: There's no drag strip installed in Assetto Corsa to test at.
lines.garage.no_strip.title: No Strip
lines.garage.strip_failed:
Could not go to the strip:

{error}
lines.garage.impound.now: The police have this car in the impound. It can be collected now for {fee}.
lines.garage.impound.until: The police have this car in the impound until {until:dddd d MMMM}, {until:h:mm tt}. Collecting it will cost {fee}.
lines.garage.fix.repairs: The Repairs button sorts it out.
lines.garage.fix.repairs_and_gas: The Repairs button sorts out the rest; fill it up at the gas station.
lines.garage.fix.gas: Fill it up at the gas station.
lines.garage.fix.repairs_and_gas.overnight: The Repairs button sorts out the rest; the tank is filled overnight.
lines.garage.station.wont_make_it: Your car won't make it to the gas station: {problem}.
lines.garage.end_day.ask.left: Call it a day? The rest of today ({hours}h {minutes:D2}m) goes by, and you pick up tomorrow at {morning}.
lines.garage.end_day.ask: Call it a day? You pick up tomorrow at {morning}.
lines.garage.end_day.title: End the Day?
lines.garage.end_day.failed:
The day could not be ended:

{error}
lines.garage.end_day.failed.title: End of Day
lines.garage.delivery: The mailman brought what you ordered. It's on your shelf:
lines.garage.delivery.title: Delivery
lines.garage.machine_back.title: Back from the Shop
lines.garage.cars.tip: Your cars: pick another one from the lot
lines.garage.end_day.tip: Call it a day: the game picks up tomorrow morning
lines.garage.key.start.tip: Turn the key: start the engine and rev it
lines.garage.view.parts.tip: The parts view: what's in the car, and working on it
lines.garage.view.rotate.tip: Turn the car round slowly on the floor
lines.garage.view.part_show.tip: {kind}: out of sight and back, to see what is behind
lines.garage.view.stand.tip: The engine stand: where engines come apart
lines.garage.view.turn_over.tip: Turn the engine upside down on the stand, to get at the crankshaft and the oil pan
lines.garage.collect.tip: Pay the impound and bring the car home
lines.garage.repairs.tip: What the races did to the car and what fixing it costs
lines.garage.sell.tip: Trade the car in at a dealer, or put it in the paper
lines.garage.free_run.tip: Take the car out on your own, on what its parts make of it. An hour goes by.
lines.garage.test_and_tune.tip: An hour at the drag strip on your own: pass after pass, each with its own tree and timeslip. Nothing at stake but the car's wear.
lines.garage.engine.pedal.tip: Hold to rev: press lower for more. Or hold W / Space.
lines.garage.engine.not_evaluated: the engine could not be evaluated: {error}
lines.workbench.stand_empty: The stand is empty. Pull an engine out of a car, or put one from the shelf on it.
lines.workbench.off.to_shelf: It goes on the shelf as it is.
lines.workbench.off.to_stand.strips: A big job. It goes on the engine stand; {strips} come off onto the shelf.
lines.workbench.off.to_stand: A big job. It goes on the engine stand.
lines.workbench.off.stand_taken: A big job. The stand is taken, so it goes on the shelf as it is.
lines.workbench.attached.one: Comes off with the part that is on it.
lines.workbench.attached.other: Comes off with the {count} parts that are on it.
lines.workbench.hint.stand_empty: The stand is empty. Put an engine on it first.
lines.workbench.axle.on_leaves: The rear axle sits on this leaf spring. Take the axle off first.
lines.workbench.axle.needs_leaves: The rear axle sits on its leaf springs. Put both rear leaves on first.
lines.workbench.hint.to_stand: Put it on the stand to take it apart.
lines.workbench.hint.stand_taken: The stand is taken. Take its engine off first.
lines.workbench.hint.no_car: There is no car here to put it on.
lines.workbench.hint.bay_taken: The engine bay is taken. Pull that engine first, or put this one on the stand.
lines.workbench.hint.no_fit_engine: It does not fit anywhere on this engine as it is.
lines.workbench.hint.no_fit_car: It does not fit anywhere on this car as it is.
lines.workbench.hint.one_place: Click the glowing part in the car to mount it.
lines.workbench.hint.places: It fits in {count} places: click the one you want.
lines.workbench.shelf.empty: Nothing on the shelf. Parts you take off a car or buy end up here.
lines.workbench.put_on_stand.tip: Bolt it to the engine stand to take it apart. What is in the way of the stand, and the radiator, come off onto the shelf.
lines.workbench.take_apart.tip: Take off what is mounted on it, here on the shelf
lines.workbench.put_in_car.tip: A big job: the engine goes in the selected car's empty engine bay
lines.workbench.help: Click a part to pick it. Drag to look around, scroll to get closer.
lines.workbench.rebuild.price.exchange: {cost} with the core · {time} there and back · up to {after}%
lines.workbench.work.skip.tip: See it done now: the job and its time are the same
lines.carinfo.impound.held: Held until {until:dddd d MMMM}, {fee} to collect
lines.repair.title: Repairs
lines.repair.not_fit.dry: Not fit to race: {problems}. Fill it up at the gas station.
lines.repair.races_damaged: It races as it is, with its damage.
lines.repair.nothing: Nothing to fix: the car is in good shape.
lines.career.title: Career

lines.career.milestone.title: Milestone Complete
lines.career.path_unlocked.title: Path Unlocked
lines.victory.title: VICTORY!
